title: PNT-based asymptotic for prime gaps in short intervals

problemStatement.formal: ShortIntervalPNT theta states the density asymptotic for h = x^theta; the file proves that this density input implies eventual PrimeGapConjecture theta and records an RH-conditional axiom for theta > 1/2.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize how short-interval density estimates imply prime-gap existence bounds, with PNT long-interval algebra and an RH-conditional short-interval axiom.
whyMatters: Distinguishes density asymptotics from mere prime existence in a gap
Connects PNT-scale intervals, RH-conditional short intervals, and prime-gap conjectures
Provides the parent context for the Cramer implication and filter-algebra subfiles

proven: rh_implies_density_for_all_theta_gt_half from the recorded RH-conditional axiom
open: shortIntervalPNT_rh_conditional is the deep RH/von-Koch style axiom
Sublinear short-interval density below the RH range is not proved here
